g.text: CTIS public API: euclinicaltrials.eu/ctis-public-api. Unofficial, undocumented, no auth. Fields as seen in real responses on 2026-10-31.
* = a field TrialWatch relies on. Types: str, int, bool, list, obj; date = 'YYYY-MM-DD', ts = ISO timestamp. -> ref.x = code decoded by that table in db.excalidraw.
CTIS timestamps carry no time zone (e.g. 2026-08-14T03:37:46.157584519) and the API does not say which one; confirm before converting them to UTC.
List trials page by page (what the portal's search screen calls)
pagination.page int page number, starts at 1
searchCriteria obj filters; all null = every trial
One short summary per trial; dates here are dd/mm/yyyy text, not ISO
pagination.totalPages int pages at this page size
pagination.nextPage bool false on the last page
data[] list one summary per trial:
* ctNumber str EU CT number -> ctis.trial
ctTitle, shortTitle str full and short title
sponsor, sponsorType str sponsor name and type, as text
trialPhase str phase as text, not a code
* lastUpdated str last change: drives ctis sync
Full record (~60 kB). Stored untouched in ctis.trial_snapshot.payload. Unknown number: 200 with {}
* ctStatus str overall status as text, e.g. Ended
* endDateEU date trial ended in the EU/EEA
publishDate ts when CTIS published this version
* trialGlobalEndDate date ended everywhere: results due +1 yr
* trialEvents[] list per country: early end, halts
* summaryResults[] list technical results summary posted
title, fileType str file name; usually PDF
authorizedApplication obj the authorised trial itself:
authorizedPartI obj the part shared by all countries:
.trialDuration obj estimated start and end dates
authorizedPartsII[] list per country: sites, status history
Long paths are shortened: e.g. .trialCategory.trialPhase sits under
Two steps. Not built yet: next for results PDFs
* url str presigned S3 link, valid ~5 min
(body) PDF the file itself, e.g. type 103
Fetch step 2 right away: the link expires.
Planned. From public docs, not yet checked against live data
query str e.g. the CT or EudraCT number
resultType str lite | core (core adds abstract)
pageSize int results per page, up to 1000
cursorMark str * for page 1, then nextCursorMark
nextCursorMark str token for the next page
* pmid, pmcid, doi str publication identifiers
* title, journalTitle str what and where
CTIS endpoint (used or next in line)
planned source, not built or verified yet
